title: CAD Neural Drawing Foundation — Deep Learning CAD Synthesis
brief: Build the neural CAD generation foundation. Transformer-based CAD sequence generation, feature extraction from JM Die corpus, reasoning chains for design decisions, accuracy validation infrastructure. This is the FOUNDATION missing from PRISM — currently 248 CAM engines but 0 CAD generation engines.

sessions.title: Neural CAD Core Infrastructure

reference: JM Die 24,545 programs for training corpus

sessions.intent: After this session: PRISM has core neural infrastructure to represent CAD operations as learnable sequences. Can tokenize CAD sketches, features, and operations. Foundation for generation.

sessions.title: CAD Sequence Tokenizer + Training Pipeline

reference: CAD corpus from JM Die (24,545 programs)

sessions.intent: After this session: PRISM can parse CAD files into tokenized sequences and train models on the JM Die corpus. Start building the CAD language model.

sessions.title: Neural CAD Generation Engine Core
sessions.intent: After this session: PRISM can generate valid CAD sequences from learned patterns. Output is parametric model code that compiles to valid BREP geometry.

sessions.title: CAD Reasoning + Chain-of-Thought
sessions.intent: After this session: PRISM can EXPLAIN its CAD generation decisions with chain-of-thought reasoning. Design choices become auditable.

sessions.title: Accuracy Validation + MCP Wiring

formulas: Geometric accuracy metrics (Hausdorff distance, Chamfer distance)

sessions.intent: After this session: CAD neural foundation is callable via MCP actions. Users can invoke neural CAD generation through /agi-cad-generate. Regression tests cover 100+ JM Die parts.

units.title: CADTokenRepresentationEngine — CAD as Learnable Language
units.completion_note: Files swept into concurrent session MIO commit 3a6bd5aa5 — see files_created list; U-DAGI01 changes are isolated and identifiable by path. Engine + vocab + 45-test suite (exit-gate 25+) + cadDispatcher wiring (tokenize/detokenize) + cad-token-vocabulary-guard hook + /cad-tokenize skill all landed. Build: tsc clean, 45/45 tests green, esbuild 3.3s.
units.description: Create the foundational representation that treats CAD operations as tokens. Sketch primitives (line, arc, circle), constraints (parallel, tangent, dimension), features (extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, shell, pattern), booleans (union, cut, intersect) all become vocabulary tokens.
steps: Define CAD token vocabulary: 250+ tokens covering sketches/features/constraints/booleans
Implement detokenization back to each native format
Add position encoding for parametric values
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: 25+ unit tests passing covering all 7 CAD formats
Round-trip test: CAD file → tokens → CAD file produces identical geometry
Tokenization handles all primitive sketch entities
Vocabulary covers 95%+ of JM Die program operations
exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Machinist sees tokens that map 1:1 to recognizable CAD operations

abort_criteria: Round-trip fails on >10% of test cases

units.title: CADKnowledgeGraphEngine — CAD Operations Relationship Graph
units.completion_note: Engine: src/engines/CADKnowledgeGraphEngine.ts (~430 LOC). Tests: 27/27 pass (exit-gate 20+). Covers all 4 JM Die archetypes (lathe shaft, mill pocket, wire EDM cavity, sinker EDM electrode), Johnson DFS cycle detection (including self-loops + dedup), orphan detection with Plane/Assembly root whitelist, transitive ancestors/descendants, JSON-LD round-trip identity, full BaseEngine contract. Dispatcher: prism_cad +graph_build +graph_query. Hook: cad-graph-integrity.mjs (surface + cycle + dangling-edge guard). Skill: /cad-graph.
units.description: Build a knowledge graph of CAD operations and their dependencies. Nodes = features, edges = dependencies (this pocket needs this face, this hole needs this plane). Enables topology-aware generation.
steps: Define graph node types: Sketch, Plane, Feature, Body, Assembly
Define edge types: references, modifies, constrains, contains
Implement graph construction from tokenized CAD
Implement graph traversal for dependency analysis
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: Graph correctly models all JM Die part types (lathe, mill, wire EDM, sinker EDM)

abort_criteria: Graph complexity exceeds O(n^2) for parts with >100 features
Circular dependency detection misses known cases

units.title: CADCorpusIngesterEngine — JM Die Training Corpus

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 36 tests > 15 gate; classify/ingest/dedup/stats/toJsonl all covered; BaseEngine contract exercised; FNV-1a hash verified deterministic + distinct.

units.description: Ingest the 24,545 JM Die programs as training corpus. Parse STEP/CAD files from customer folders, tokenize via U-DAGI01, build knowledge graphs via U-DAGI02. Output: training-ready dataset.
steps: Scan H:/PRISM/JM DIE/ recursively for CAD files (.step, .stp, .iges, .sldprt, .ipt, .x_t)
Parallel parse and tokenize using U-DAGI01
Build knowledge graphs per part using U-DAGI02
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Every JM Die customer has training data in corpus

units.title: CADSequenceTrainerEngine — Train CAD Language Model

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 32 tests > 20 gate; PRNG/shuffle/split/batching/adapters/evaluate/train-loop/checkpoint all covered; MockBackend (Markov count-table) passes determinism checks; early stopping + divergence abort + perplexity + feature validity verified.

units.description: Train a transformer-based CAD language model on the JM Die corpus. Learn parametric CAD patterns, feature sequences, and design idioms. Uses existing LoRA infrastructure from LatheLoRAContinualLearningEngine.
steps: Integrate with Ollama/codellama for local training OR Docker: physics-agent
Implement training loop with gradient accumulation
Integrate LoRA adapters for continual learning
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

units.title: CADFeatureEmbeddingEngine — Dense Feature Representation

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 28 tests > 15 gate; embed/batch/cache/flat-index/vptree-index/search-metrics all covered; 10k search < 100ms verified; MockEmbeddingBackend (hash-based) passes determinism checks.

units.description: Extract dense embeddings from the trained CAD model. Use for similarity search, feature retrieval, and hybrid retrieval-augmented generation.
steps: Extract final-layer embeddings from trained model
Build FAISS-like index for fast similarity search
Add embedding cache to avoid recomputation
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: Similarity search finds relevant JM Die parts for query

abort_criteria: Similarity search returns irrelevant results (mean reciprocal rank < 0.5)

units.title: CADRetrievalAugmentationEngine — RAG for CAD Generation

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 32 tests > 15 gate; filter/retrieve/format/rerank/augment all covered; customer+machine+feature filters verified; 1k retrieval < 200ms; MockGenerator passes context check.

units.description: Retrieval-augmented CAD generation. Before generating, retrieve similar JM Die parts as in-context examples. Improves accuracy and customer-specific fit.
steps: Query embedding engine for top-k similar parts
Format retrieved parts as in-context examples
Support customer-filtered retrieval (e.g., only ALCOA parts)
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: Retrieved parts demonstrably improve generation accuracy (+10% vs baseline)
exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Generated CAD reflects customer-specific patterns (e.g., ALCOA styling)

abort_criteria: RAG provides no measurable improvement over baseline

units.title: NeuralCADGenerationEngine — Core Generation Engine
units.description: THE CORE ENGINE. Generates valid CAD sequences from descriptions. Accepts natural language, part specs, or blueprint data. Outputs parametric CAD code (CadQuery preferred, FreeCAD fallback).
steps: Accept multi-modal input: text, blueprint OCR, feature list
Generate token sequence via trained model
Return generated CAD with confidence score
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: 30+ unit tests pass covering simple/medium/complex parts
Generation success rate > 85% on validation set
Generated code compiles 95%+ of the time
Handles 20+ common part patterns (brackets, plates, shafts, gears, pulleys)
exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Generated CAD models resemble real-world JM Die parts

abort_criteria: Generated CAD has systematic geometric errors

units.title: BlueprintToCADGenerationEngine — Print to Model
units.description: Convert blueprint OCR output to 3D CAD model. Uses BlueprintVisionOCREngine (existing) + NeuralCADGenerationEngine (U-DAGI07).
steps: Apply neural generation with blueprint data as constraint
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Generated CAD matches blueprint to within tolerance

units.title: TextToCADGenerationEngine — Natural Language to Model

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 28 tests > 20 gate; parseText/detectRefinements/applyRefinement/context/generate all covered; dimension extraction (mm/inch/thread), 12 feature types, material + machine detection, iterative refinement verified.

units.description: Natural language CAD generation. 'Make a flanged bushing with 20mm bore, 40mm OD, 10mm flange' → valid CAD model.
steps: Parse natural language to structured spec (regex + LLM fallback)
Support iterative refinement ('add a keyway', 'make the bore 22mm')
Maintain conversation context for multi-turn refinement
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: Natural language parsing handles 50+ test prompts

abort_criteria: Iterative refinement drifts from original intent

units.title: CADReasoningChainEngine — Chain-of-Thought Design Decisions

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 35 tests > 20 gate; generateWithReasoning/queryWhy/getChain/listChains all covered; 9 decision categories (geometry, feature, material, DFM, constraint) + evidence sources + alternatives verified; chain storage + retrieval tested.

units.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning for CAD design decisions. 'Why fillet here? Stress concentration. Why this draft angle? Molding direction.' Makes generation auditable.
steps: Query reasoning engines: DiagnosticReasoningEngine, DecisionReasoningEngine, MultiAssetReasoningEngine
Emit reasoning[] array with design justifications
Support 'why did you do X' follow-up queries
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: Reasoning chains are non-trivial (>= 3 steps average)
Reasoning is actionable (user can modify design based on it)

units.title: DFMAwareGenerationEngine — Manufacturability-Aware CAD

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 35 tests > 20 gate; analyzeFeatures (wall/corner/depth/hole/thread/edge) + generateWithDFM (auto-fix) + fixFeatures + getEnvelope all covered; 8 materials + 3 machine types + JM Die envelope verified.

units.description: Integrate DFM (Design for Manufacturability) into generation. Avoid impossible undercuts, ensure adequate clearances, respect minimum radii.
steps: Filter generation candidates by DFM score
Apply DFM constraints during beam search
Warn on marginal DFM (radius < 0.015", thin walls)
Support JM Die capability envelope (machines, materials, tools)
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: Generated CAD passes DFM check > 90% of time (vs 60% without)
exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Generated parts can be made with JM Die's existing machines/tools

abort_criteria: Too many DFM warnings (> 30% of parts)

units.title: ToleranceAwareGenerationEngine — GD&T-Aware CAD

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 49 tests > 20 gate; applyTolerances (cylinder/hole/bore/flange/slot/boss/thread/chamfer/fillet) + generateWithTolerance (full pipeline with code) + stackCheck (RSS) + getStandard/listStandards (ITW/ALCOA/SFS/DEFAULT) + GD&T symbol rules (14 types) + datum structure (A-B-C hierarchy) all covered.

units.description: Tolerance-aware CAD generation with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) reasoning. Datum selection, tolerance stack analysis, feature control frames.
steps: Apply GD&T to generated features automatically
Support customer tolerance standards (ITW, ALCOA, etc.)
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

units.title: CADAccuracyValidatorEngine — 100% Accuracy Gate

exit_gate_actual.coverage_note: 41 tests > 25 gate; all 5 validation layers (dimensional/topology/DFM/tolerance/feature) covered; Hausdorff distance + closed manifold + hole depth ratio + RSS stack + feature match all verified; hard block on critical issues; BaseEngine contract exercised.

units.description: Multi-layer accuracy validator. Dimensional, topological, manufacturability, tolerance. 100% accuracy gate before CAM handoff.
steps: Layer 1: Dimensional check (Hausdorff distance vs spec)
Hard block if any layer fails
4-LOOP: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

measurable_criteria: True positive rate on invalid CAD > 95%
False positive rate on valid CAD < 5%
exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Validator catches issues a human inspector would catch

abort_criteria: Any validation layer has false negative rate > 10%
